description: Builds a human-readable FlipLetters Studio URL where every query parameter mirrors one flipcode line — good for short text boards you want legible in the address itself (chat messages, docs). For full fidelity or paint grids use flipletters_validate_board's share link instead. Slides are strings with | between rows.

slides.description: Each entry is one slide; | separates rows: "EGGS BENEDICT|FLAT WHITE".

name: flipletters_template_url
title: Readable template URL
